description.zh: 把素材库里的文件传到阿里云 OSS,换回一条**公网直链** —— 有些供应商只收链接不收本地文件(方舟 Seedance 的参考视频就是一例)。也能把桶里的东西拉回素材库。
description.en: Upload assets to Alibaba Cloud OSS and get a public link back — some providers only accept a URL, not a local file (Seedance's reference video is one). Also pulls objects back into the library.

description.zh: 把一份素材传上去,交回一条**限时直链**(签名在查询串里,桶不必设成公共读)。这就是「本地文件怎么变成公网链接」的答案 —— 直接粘进生成节点的参考视频那一格。
description.en: Upload an asset and hand back a time-limited direct link (the signature lives in the query string, so the bucket need not be public-read). This is how a local file becomes a URL.

description.zh: 给桶里已有的对象签一条限时直链。
description.en: Sign a time-limited direct link for an object already in the bucket.

description.zh: 把桶里的一个对象拉回素材库。**交回的是地址,由宿主搬字节** —— 进度、取消、重试都归它。
description.en: Pull an object back into the asset library. The plugin hands over a URL and the host moves the bytes — progress, cancel and retry all come for free.

description.zh: 列出桶里某个前缀下的对象(路径、大小、修改时间)。
description.en: List objects under a prefix (key, size, last modified).

description.zh: 把素材库里的文件传到Amazon S3,换回一条**公网直链** —— 有些供应商只收链接不收本地文件(方舟 Seedance 的参考视频就是一例)。也能把桶里的东西拉回素材库。
description.en: Upload assets to Amazon S3 and get a public link back — some providers only accept a URL, not a local file (Seedance's reference video is one). Also pulls objects back into the library.

description.en: Sign a time-limited direct link for an object already in the bucket.

description.en: Pull an object back into the asset library. The plugin hands over a URL and the host moves the bytes — progress, cancel and retry all come for free.

description.zh: 列出桶里某个前缀下的对象(路径、大小、修改时间)。
description.en: List objects under a prefix (key, size, last modified).

description.zh: 在百度网盘和素材库之间搬文件。拉:用 pan_list 或 pan_search 找到 fs_id,再用 pan_import 导进来。传:用 pan_upload 把素材库里的东西存到网盘(传 asset_id 和目标路径)。
description.en: Move files between Baidu Netdisk and the asset library. To pull: find an fs_id with pan_list or pan_search, then bring it in with pan_import. To push: use pan_upload to save something from the asset library to the netdisk (pass an asset_id and a target path).

description.zh: 列出百度网盘某个目录下的文件和子目录。返回每一项的 fs_id、文件名、大小、是不是目录。fs_id 是后面 pan_import 要用的。
description.en: List the files and sub-directories under a Baidu Netdisk directory. Each entry carries its fs_id, name, size and whether it is a directory. The fs_id is what pan_import takes.

description.zh: 按文件名在百度网盘里搜索。找不准路径时用这个,比一层层 pan_list 快。返回同样带 fs_id。
description.en: Search Baidu Netdisk by file name. Use this when you don't know the exact path — it beats walking down with pan_list. Results carry fs_id the same way.

description.zh: 把百度网盘里的一个文件拉进素材库。传 pan_list / pan_search 给出的 fs_id。返回 asset_id,之后就和别的素材一样用。
description.en: Pull one file from Baidu Netdisk into the asset library. Pass an fs_id from pan_list or pan_search. Returns an asset_id you can use like any other asset.

description.zh: 把素材库里的一个文件传到百度网盘。传 asset_id 和网盘上的目标路径(如 /我的资源/成片.mp4)。
description.en: Send one file from the asset library to Baidu Netdisk. Pass an asset_id and the target path on the netdisk (e.g. /My files/final.mp4).

description.zh: 使用你选择的智能体操作本机 Blender：查询场景、编辑模型和材质。3D 工作台可发送场景与镜头，接收加工结果并保留 .blend 工程。需安装配套 Blender MCP 2.0.3 Add-on。
description.en: Use your chosen agent to inspect and edit local Blender models and materials. Send scenes and cameras from the 3D studio, receive edited models, and keep .blend projects. Requires the matching Blender MCP 2.0.3 add-on.

description.zh: 把一台 ComfyUI(本机或局域网)接进 Mosael:它保存的每张工作流都是一个图像 / 视频生成模型(参数、参考图、蒙版、首尾帧、视频输入自动识别,进度实时、能真的取消);另有一组工具 —— 原样跑任意一张工作流并交回全部产出(放大、抠图、局部重绘、修脸、补帧都用用户自己的图),列出工作流与模型文件,看显卡和队列,把历史产出收进素材库,以及中断、清队列、释放显存。
description.en: Connect a ComfyUI server (local or on your LAN): every saved workflow becomes an image / video generation model (parameters, reference images, masks, first/last frames and video inputs detected automatically, live progress, real cancellation). Plus tools to run any workflow as-is and collect every output (upscale, background removal, inpainting, face restore, frame interpolation — with the user's own graphs), list workflows and model files, check the GPU and queue, import past outputs into the asset library, and interrupt / clear the queue / free VRAM.

description.zh: 替 Mosael 在这台 ComfyUI 上列出模型、做一次生成。只给宿主调。
description.en: Lists models and runs generations on this ComfyUI server for Mosael. Host-only.

description.zh: 这台 ComfyUI 上保存的每张工作流:能喂什么(图 / 蒙版 / 视频 / 音频各接在哪个节点)、能调什么、会交出什么、看起来在做什么(放大、局部重绘、抠图…)。先用它挑一张,再用 run_workflow 跑。
description.en: Every workflow saved on this ComfyUI: what it takes (which node loads each image / mask / video / audio), what can be tuned, what it outputs, and what it seems to do (upscale, inpaint, background removal…). Pick one here, then run it with run_workflow.

description.zh: 原样跑一张 ComfyUI 工作流,交回**全部**产出(每个保存 / 预览节点的每一个文件进素材库,显示文字的节点说的话在 texts 里)。图、蒙版、视频、音频按 list_workflows 给的顺序接到读素材的节点上;任意节点上的值用 values 改。跑得久的(视频)可以 wait: false 只提交,之后用 import_outputs 取回。
description.en: Runs a ComfyUI workflow as-is and returns **every** output (each file from every save / preview node goes into the asset library; text shown by display nodes is in texts). Images, masks, videos and audio go to the loader nodes in the order list_workflows reports; values overrides any literal input. For long runs (video) pass wait: false to only submit, then fetch the outputs with import_outputs.

description.zh: 把 ComfyUI 历史里的产出收进素材库:给任务号就取那一个(还在跑可以等一会儿),不给就取最近几次。在 ComfyUI 界面里跑出来的东西也能这样拿回来。
description.en: Imports outputs from ComfyUI's history into the asset library: a task id fetches that one (optionally waiting while it runs), otherwise the most recent runs. Also works for things run directly in the ComfyUI interface.

description.zh: ComfyUI 的版本、显卡与空闲显存、内存,以及队列里在跑 / 排队的任务数。
description.en: ComfyUI version, GPU and free VRAM, RAM, and how many tasks are running / queued.

description.zh: 服务器上装了哪些模型文件,按目录分:checkpoints、loras、vae、upscale_models、controlnet、diffusion_models…
description.en: Model files installed on the server by folder: checkpoints, loras, vae, upscale_models, controlnet, diffusion_models…

description.zh: 停下 ComfyUI 正在跑的任务。给了任务号就只停那一个(在跑的中断,排队的删掉),不会误伤别人的任务。
description.en: Stops the task ComfyUI is running. With a task id only that one is stopped (interrupted if running, removed if queued), leaving other people's tasks alone.

description.zh: 清掉 ComfyUI 里所有**排队中**的任务(在跑的不动)。同一台服务器上别人排的任务也会被清掉。
description.en: Clears every **queued** task in ComfyUI (the running one is untouched). Tasks queued by other people on the same server are cleared too.

description.zh: 让 ComfyUI 卸载模型、释放显存。下一次生成要重新加载模型,会慢一些。
description.en: Asks ComfyUI to unload models and free VRAM. The next run reloads its models and is slower.

description.zh: 用代码做动画视频,零生成费用:知识点讲解、公式推导、代码演示、数据图表。要讲准确的东西(文字、公式、步骤、数字)用它;要真实画面(人物、场景、实拍感)用视频生成模型。讲解视频给内容就能出片;更自由的画面写一段 Remotion 组件代码。需要本机装有 Node.js 18+。Remotion 对个人与 3 人以内的公司免费,更大的公司需要购买 Remotion 公司许可。
description.en: Make animated videos with code, at no generation cost: lesson explainers, formula walk-throughs, code demos, data charts. Use it when accuracy matters (text, formulas, steps, numbers); use a video generation model for realistic footage. Explainers need only content; anything freer is a short Remotion component. Needs Node.js 18+ on this computer. Remotion is free for individuals and companies of up to 3 people; larger companies need a Remotion company license.

description.zh: 安装 Remotion 与渲染用的浏览器。第一次要几十秒到几分钟,之后几乎是瞬间完成。渲染工具在环境缺失时会自动补,但第一次最好在插件页先跑一下它。
description.en: Install Remotion and the rendering browser. The first run takes from tens of seconds to a few minutes; after that it is near-instant. The render tools fill in anything missing, but run this once from the plugin page first.

description.zh: 给内容,出一段知识点讲解视频(mp4,进素材库):标题 → 一节一节讲(小标题、逐条出现的要点、KaTeX 公式、逐行出现的代码、提示)→ 要点回顾。每段多长按内容算,不用给时间轴。讲数学、物理、编程、概念解释、操作步骤都合适。
description.en: Turn content into a lesson explainer video (mp4, into the asset library): a title, then sections (heading, points that appear one by one, a KaTeX formula, code that appears line by line, a note), then key takeaways. Timing follows the content; no timeline needed. Good for maths, physics, programming, concepts and how-tos.

description.zh: 用一段 Remotion 组件代码渲染动画(mp4,进素材库)。代码是一个 TSX 模块,`export default` 一个组件,它收到 `{ data }`(即这里传的 data);用 useCurrentFrame / useVideoConfig / interpolate / spring / AbsoluteFill / Sequence(都从 'remotion' 导入)做动画。只能 import react、remotion、katex。报错会原样返回,改了再调即可。讲解类内容优先用「讲解视频」。
description.en: Render an animation from a Remotion component (mp4, into the asset library). The code is a TSX module that `export default`s a component receiving `{ data }` (the data given here); animate with useCurrentFrame / useVideoConfig / interpolate / spring / AbsoluteFill / Sequence from 'remotion'. Only react, remotion and katex can be imported. Errors come back verbatim, so fix and call again. Prefer the explainer tool for lesson-style content.

description.en: Small text utilities: count words, pull out hashtags, draft title candidates. All local, no permissions needed.

description.zh: 统计文本的字数、词数与预计口播时长(按 4.5 字/秒)。
description.en: Count characters and words in a text, and estimate read-aloud time (at 4.5 characters per second).

description.zh: 从文案中提取 #话题# 与 #hashtag 标签。
description.en: Pull #topic# and #hashtag tags out of a piece of copy.

description.zh: 读抖音 / TikTok / 小红书 / B站 / 快手等平台的公开数据:作品详情、作者主页与作品列表、关键词搜索、热榜。用于选题调研、对标账号分析、找素材灵感。
description.en: Read public data from Douyin / TikTok / Xiaohongshu / Bilibili / Kuaishou and other platforms: post details, creator profiles and their posts, keyword search, trending charts. For topic research, studying comparable accounts, and finding footage ideas.
